XmlData.​MovingNode
public
XmlData.​MovingNode

Information about the moves.

There are 2 types: start and end. If a sequence has 10 frame sequences, the other 8 frames will interpolate the values from start and end.

Variables
X
[XmlElement("x")]
public string X

How many pixels to move in the X axis.

Y
[XmlElement("y")]
public string Y

How many pixels to move in the Y axis.

OffsetY
[XmlElement("offsety")]
public int OffsetY

Graphical offset, from the physical position calculated for the pet.

Opacity
[XmlElement("opacity")]
public double Opacity

Opacity from 0.0 (invisible) to 1.0 (opaque).

Interval
[XmlElement("interval")]
public string Interval

Interval until the next sequence is executed.
